    8: - **STRUCTURAL THEOREM** (machine-epsilon proof events): #1, #3, #6, #14, #17, #18, #28, #30, #31, #33, #38
    9: - **WALL DISCOVERY** (constraint-region exclusion events): #2, #4, #11, #20, #24
   10: - **PARADIGM SHIFT** (framing-error correction events): #7, #8, #9, #15, #19
